name: Goi ca trich
summary: Raw herring with mint, onion, shredded coconut, and crisp vegetables, eaten in rice paper. The dip is Phú Quốc fish sauce, garlic, chili, and roasted peanuts. The nature account does not mention coconut. Both descriptions stay. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Quoc. The specialty-seafood account and the nature account both name the salad.
texture: The specialty-seafood account calls the vegetables crisp. It does not describe the fish further.
taste: The specialty-seafood account calls the salad aromatic and fresh. The dip is fish sauce, chopped garlic and chili, and roasted peanuts. The nature account names the salad and does not describe coconut or the dip.
howToEat: Mix the herring with mint, onion, shredded coconut, and crisp vegetables, then wrap what you want in rice paper and dip it. That is the specialty-seafood account. The whisper account also says herring salad tossed with shredded coconut.
Any time of day on the specialty-seafood account, and it calls the salad a meal for a hot day. Lunch or dinner by the water on the nature account. Both stay. A price is Check on arrival.
where: By the water on the nature account. No stall was named. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Goi ca trich — raw herring salad on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Gỏi cá trích is raw herring in rice paper. One account adds shredded coconut. Another does not. A price is Check on arrival.
